versions.changelog: Install lines pinned packet-audit@1.0.0 in 1.1.0; RC5 could not catch it because it read a version key the frontmatter does not have. RC5 now reads metadata.version, fails loudly when unreadable, checks install commands only, and names the stale pin. 9 new gate tests.

Reads PDFs with no dependency: bundled stdlib extractor (objects/ObjStm, Flate/ASCIIHex/ASCII85, page tree, Tj/TJ with ToUnicode CMaps and /Widths word gaps). Validated against pdftotext at 0.94-1.00 recall; glyph-positioned pages 0.24 -> 0.99. Encrypted and scanned PDFs are cited with the exact reason instead of being missed.
First release: deterministic submission-packet audit with three bundled profiles, SHA-256 manifest, and citation-bearing findings.
